title.narrative: UNICEF and partners delivered multi-sectoral case management services to 118,778 children while birth registrations were completed for 540,465 children. UNICEF provided technical support and resources, helped train the social service workforce, enhanced police capacity, and improved coordination with the health system for prosecutorial evidence in cases of bodily harm or sexual abuse.
